mapper.sql: room_id, provider, provider_session_key, public_file_id, lesson_id, question_id, source_material_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, room_title, status, current_version, current_file_name, current_file_path, current_file_extension, current_mime_type, current_file_size, current_sha256, creator_user_id, modifier_user_id, last_open_time, last_save_time, last_callback_type, last_callback_status, last_wps_request_id, last_error_message, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_collab_room WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT FROM biz_collab_room WHERE public_file_id = #{publicFileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_collab_room (provider, provider_session_key, public_file_id, lesson_id, question_id, source_material_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, room_title, status, current_version, current_file_name, current_file_path, current_file_extension, current_mime_type, current_file_size, current_sha256, creator_user_id, modifier_user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{provider}, #{providerSessionKey}, #{publicFileId}, #{lessonId}, #{questionId}, #{sourceMaterialId}, #{deptId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{roomTitle}, #{status}, #{currentVersion}, #{currentFileName}, #{currentFilePath}, #{currentFileExtension}, #{currentMimeType}, #{currentFileSize}, #{currentSha256}, #{creatorUserId}, #{modifierUserId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_collab_room SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND dept_id = #{deptId}
UPDATE biz_collab_room SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
UPDATE biz_collab_room SET provider = #{provider}, provider_session_key = #{providerSessionKey}, update_time = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
UPDATE biz_collab_room SET last_open_time = #{openTime}, update_time = #{openTime} WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_collab_revision (room_id, version_no, file_name, file_path, file_size, sha256, wps_digest_type, wps_digest, manual_save, saved_by_user_id, create_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{versionNo}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{digestType}, #{digest}, #{manualSave}, #{savedByUserId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select r.revision_id as revisionId, r.room_id as roomId, r.version_no as versionNo, r.file_name as fileName, r.file_size as fileSize, r.sha256 as sha256, r.manual_save as manualSave, r.saved_by_user_id as savedByUserId, r.create_time as createTime, u.nick_name as savedByName from biz_collab_revision r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.saved_by_user_id where r.room_id = #{roomId} order by r.version_no desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_collab_upload_ticket (ticket_token, room_id, expected_version, expected_file_name, expected_file_size, expected_digest_type, expected_digest, manual_save, temp_file_path, status, requester_user_id, expires_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ticketToken}, #{roomId}, #{expectedVersion}, #{expectedFileName}, #{expectedFileSize}, #{expectedDigestType}, #{expectedDigest}, #{manualSave}, #{tempFilePath}, #{status}, #{requesterUserId}, #{expiresTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_collab_upload_ticket WHERE ticket_token = #{ticketToken} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_collab_room SET current_version = #{nextVersion}, current_file_name = #{fileName}, current_file_path = #{filePath}, current_file_extension = #{fileExtension}, current_mime_type = #{mimeType}, current_file_size = #{fileSize}, current_sha256 = #{sha256}, modifier_user_id = #{modifierUserId}, last_save_time = #{saveTime}, update_time = #{saveTime} WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND current_version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_collab_callback_event (room_id, public_file_id, callback_type, callback_status, wps_request_id, user_id, remote_ip, duration_ms, error_code, error_message, create_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{publicFileId}, #{callbackType}, #{callbackStatus}, #{wpsRequestId}, #{userId}, #{remoteIp}, #{durationMs}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT activity_id AS activityId,lesson_id AS lessonId,dept_id AS deptId,entry_year AS entryYear,class_code AS classCode,snapshot_id AS snapshotId,activity_title AS activityTitle,status,frozen_time AS frozenTime,create_time AS createTime FROM biz_collab_activity WHERE activity_id=#{activityId}

SELECT activity_id AS activityId,lesson_id AS lessonId,entry_year AS entryYear,class_code AS classCode,activity_title AS activityTitle,status,frozen_time AS frozenTime,create_time AS createTime FROM biz_collab_activity WHERE lesson_id=#{lessonId} AND dept_id=#{deptId} AND status != 'REPLACED' ORDER BY activity_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_collab_activity WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId}

SELECT gt.snapshot_group_id AS snapshotGroupId,gt.task_version_id AS taskVersionId,gt.room_id AS roomId,t.version_name AS versionName,t.question_id AS questionId,t.source_material_id AS sourceMaterialId FROM biz_collab_group_task gt JOIN biz_collab_task_version t ON t.task_version_id=gt.task_version_id WHERE gt.activity_id=#{activityId} ORDER BY gt.snapshot_group_id

SELECT snapshot_group_id AS snapshotGroupId,group_no AS groupNo,group_name AS groupName,leader_student_id AS leaderStudentId FROM biz_lesson_group_snapshot_group WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} ORDER BY sort_no,group_no
SELECT student_id FROM biz_student WHERE user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId,e.room_id AS roomId,e.user_id AS userId,e.student_id AS studentId,e.event_type AS eventType,e.event_detail AS eventDetail,e.create_time AS createTime,COALESCE(CONCAT(s.student_no,' ',u.nick_name),u.user_name) AS actorName FROM biz_collab_operation_event e LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=e.user_id WHERE e.room_id=#{roomId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC,e.event_id DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT g.group_name AS groupName,sm.student_id AS studentId,CONCAT(s.student_no,' ',COALESCE(u.nick_name,s.student_no)) AS name,(SELECT MAX(e.create_time) FROM biz_collab_operation_event e WHERE e.room_id=gt.room_id AND e.event_type='ENTER' AND e.student_id=sm.student_id) AS enterTime FROM biz_collab_group_task gt JOIN biz_lesson_group_snapshot_group g ON g.snapshot_group_id=gt.snapshot_group_id JOIN biz_lesson_group_snapshot_member sm ON sm.snapshot_group_id=g.snapshot_group_id JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=sm.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE gt.room_id=#{roomId} ORDER BY sm.sort_no

SELECT q.question_id AS questionId,q.question_content AS questionContent,q.grade AS grade,q.semester AS semester,q.lesson_num AS lessonNum,q.preview_path AS previewPath,m.material_id AS materialId,m.original_file_name AS fileName,m.file_extension AS fileExtension,m.file_size AS fileSize,m.resource_path AS resourcePath FROM biz_question q JOIN biz_practical_question_material m ON m.question_id=q.question_id AND m.material_type='STARTER' WHERE q.question_type='practical' AND q.practical_mode='FILE' AND (q.is_public IN ('Y','1') OR q.creator_id=#{creatorId}) AND q.grade=#{grade} AND q.semester=#{semester} AND q.lesson_num=#{lessonNum} AND (q.question_content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR m.original_file_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY q.question_id DESC,m.file_order

SELECT COALESCE(u.nick_name,u.user_name) AS name,MAX(e.create_time) AS enterTime FROM biz_collab_operation_event e JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=e.user_id AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE e.room_id=#{roomId} AND e.event_type='ENTER' AND e.student_id IS NULL GROUP BY e.user_id ORDER BY enterTime DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_collab_group_task gt JOIN biz_collab_activity a ON a.activity_id=gt.activity_id JOIN biz_lesson_group_snapshot_member sm ON sm.snapshot_group_id=gt.snapshot_group_id WHERE gt.room_id=#{roomId} AND sm.student_id=#{studentId} AND a.status IN ('OPEN','ARCHIVED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_collab_group_task WHERE room_id=#{roomId}
SELECT revision_id AS revisionId,room_id AS roomId,version_no AS versionNo,file_path AS filePath,file_name AS fileName FROM biz_collab_revision WHERE room_id=#{roomId} AND version_no=#{versionNo}

SELECT nowr.revision_id AS revisionId,nowr.room_id AS roomId,nowr.version_no AS versionNo,nowr.file_path AS filePath,prevr.file_path AS previousFilePath FROM biz_collab_revision nowr LEFT JOIN biz_collab_revision prevr ON prevr.room_id=nowr.room_id AND prevr.version_no=nowr.version_no-1 WHERE nowr.room_id=#{roomId} AND nowr.version_no=#{versionNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_collab_activity a JOIN biz_collab_group_task gt ON gt.activity_id=a.activity_id SET a.frozen_time=COALESCE(a.frozen_time,#{frozenTime}) WHERE gt.room_id=#{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id AS snapshotId,entry_year AS entryYear,class_code AS classCode,source_scheme_id AS sourceSchemeId,frozen_time AS frozenTime FROM biz_lesson_group_snapshot WHERE lesson_id=#{lessonId} AND dept_id=#{deptId} ORDER BY frozen_time DESC

SELECT q.question_id AS questionId,q.question_content AS questionContent,m.material_id AS materialId,m.original_file_name AS fileName,m.file_extension AS fileExtension,m.file_size AS fileSize,m.resource_path AS resourcePath FROM biz_question q JOIN biz_practical_question_material m ON m.question_id=q.question_id AND m.material_type='STARTER' WHERE q.question_type='practical' AND q.practical_mode='FILE' AND (q.is_public IN ('Y','1') OR q.creator_id=#{creatorId}) ORDER BY q.question_id DESC,m.file_order

SELECT m.snapshot_group_id AS snapshotGroupId,m.student_id AS studentId,s.student_no AS studentNo,COALESCE(u.nick_name,s.student_no) AS studentName FROM biz_lesson_group_snapshot_member m JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=m.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE m.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} ORDER BY m.snapshot_group_id,m.sort_no
SELECT lesson_id FROM biz_lesson WHERE lesson_id=#{lessonId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT activity_id AS activityId,lesson_id AS lessonId,snapshot_id AS snapshotId,status,frozen_time AS frozenTime FROM biz_collab_activity WHERE lesson_id=#{lessonId} AND dept_id=#{deptId} AND entry_year=#{entryYear} AND class_code=#{classCode} AND status='OPEN' ORDER BY activity_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT activity_id AS activityId,lesson_id AS lessonId,request_hash AS requestHash FROM biz_collab_activity WHERE request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_collab_activity SET status=#{status},update_time=NOW() WHERE activity_id=#{activityId}
UPDATE biz_collab_room r JOIN biz_collab_group_task gt ON gt.room_id=r.room_id SET r.status='READ_ONLY',r.update_time=NOW() WHERE gt.activity_id=#{activityId}

UPDATE biz_collab_room r LEFT JOIN biz_collab_group_task gt ON gt.room_id = r.room_id SET r.status = 'CLOSED', r.update_time = NOW() WHERE r.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND r.dept_id = #{deptId} AND r.status != 'CLOSED' AND gt.room_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_collab_room r JOIN biz_collab_group_task gt ON gt.room_id = r.room_id WHERE gt.activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.delete: DELETE d FROM biz_collab_revision_diff d JOIN biz_collab_revision r ON r.revision_id = d.revision_id WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id AS roomId,r.room_title AS roomTitle,r.current_file_name AS fileName,r.current_version AS version, r.lesson_id AS lessonId,l.lesson_title AS lessonTitle,g.group_name AS groupName,a.create_time AS createTime FROM biz_collab_activity a JOIN biz_collab_group_task gt ON gt.activity_id=a.activity_id JOIN biz_lesson_group_snapshot_group g ON g.snapshot_group_id=gt.snapshot_group_id JOIN biz_lesson_group_snapshot_member m ON m.snapshot_group_id=g.snapshot_group_id JOIN biz_collab_room r ON r.room_id=gt.room_id JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id=a.lesson_id WHERE a.status='ARCHIVED' AND r.status='READ_ONLY' AND a.dept_id=#{deptId} AND m.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY a.activity_id DESC LIMIT 100
